#30361 proposes relaxing the developer-notes LogError rule while reviewers prefer fixing the ~half of non-fatal call sites in code; the underlying doc/code mismatch is real but the resolution may belong in a code PR, so a decision on direction should precede review of this text.
#35890 is the only P4 that actually fixes instructions that break when followed (append vs overwrite); it sits at the top of P4 and should be reviewed before the purely cosmetic #36155.
result.notes: Only one PR in this category carries leverage over other work (#36101, an error-handling policy that several stalled design discussions reference), so it is the sole P2; the NACKs on its specific recommendation do not lower its priority since the decision itself is what is blocking. The P3 block is homogeneous missing-documentation work and is ordered by how often the undocumented behavior is hit by users/integrators, then by developer-facing consolidation. Nothing here is P1: no document was found that would lead a user into fund loss, backup loss, or a security-relevant misconfiguration.
